lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in semi-parallel horizontal rows along the lateral flank, transitioning from larger, isolated clusters near the gill slits to smaller, higher-density clusters in the dorsal-posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to create a lattice-like arrangement, where the circular blobs serve as primary nodes within the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper-lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient featuring high-luminance pixels on the upper surface and a shadowed transition on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The presence of several smaller fish (remoras) is noted near the ventral surface and the insertion point of the pectoral fin.
